quickref.status: BBR v1.3.2 (2012), 4-round lob. Became ~20 rounds (28 with gear) after SkyVu's Apr 25, 2014 Oliver Overhaul, through at least Aug 2018. Back to 4 by Jun 2021. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Squat Daruma jug: white face, black brows, dark neck, tan rope loop. From behind: dark-maroon faceted body (~#66181A) with yellow-outlined red-orange flame decals (~#EC4727) and a round emblem. About 0.3x a bear.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lob era: non-damaging arcing shot (wiki); never seen in flight. 2014-18 version: a cream splash crown (~#DFD7BE) spurts from the neck with white droplets (DxHcbyg9oPg).
quickref.impact_end_result: Chunky cream puffs (~#D5BBAD) and white ovals engulf the target. A glossy lime '?' with a separate dot (~#51A406-#61E51A) floats over victims, including the thrower. Controls reversed 4 s, music cut. 2018: white puffs and flat white splats. 2021: lime spike splash (~#9AFE31), attribution inferred. No damage.

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), Gas item. HUD x/1 in 2014-2016. 2026 unconfirmed.
quickref.look: Long silver blade held upright in the right hand, rising above the head (~1.0-1.2x), dark-and-gold/orange hilt. HUD icon: sword with gold-orange guard.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: One swing launches a long, thin, tapered, slightly curved flame-textured orange crescent (~#EB7F0D, core #F69520) that flies straight. Wiki: passes through walls (not observed).
quickref.impact_end_result: Struck bears get a yellow disc (~#FBCC0B) with six black spokes and a black centre over the head (radiation stage icon), plus Geiger clicks; 100 RP = explosion (wiki). The 'dark, circular radiation belt' is unseen.

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.1 week 1 (2012), 30 Gas. Fan-titled in 2026 (9nA-OaYAVzU) but not visible there.
quickref.look: Brass steampunk shotgun: green glass dome in a brass cage, two copper stacks with green gems, silver rod barrel, gold honeycomb muzzle disc (2018 demo render).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Wiki: 'a quick spread of damaging green steam'. No frame shows it firing: sDVr1PqEHC4, _JeiI0KrSbA and 9nA-OaYAVzU frames show other weapons.
quickref.impact_end_result: Unknown. The steam colour (green vs white) is unverified.

quickref.status: Default since BBR v1.0. HUD 1 (2013), 3 (Mar 2014), 4 (Aug 2014; Jul 2015 with Ammo +2). Named on Steam 2026 and seen in the 2026 trailer.
quickref.look: Coral hex shoulder tube with glowing orange panels and grey hex collars. The muzzle end has a pink hex cap around a dark bore, with a grey-coral checker band right behind the cap. About 0.7x long.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Launch: a burst of round grey smoke puffs and a dotted grey puff trail (2015). 2026 trailer rocket: grey hex nose, glowing orange panels (~#FFAF0E), red-studded rear collar, spiky orange flame tail (Bearzooka link inferred).
quickref.impact_end_result: 2026 trailer: a faceted orange-yellow, white-edged blast, then a soft yellow fireball (~#FFE01E) that flings the target upward (cause inferred). 2015: grey puff cloud downrange. Self-damage documented ('very prone to suicide').

quickref.status: BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014), 45 Gas. HUD x/130 in 2014 vs wiki 80 (100 max with gear); 100/100 in 2016. Nerfed after release.
quickref.look: Dark gunmetal three-barrel gun (HUD icon dark green). Not clearly seen in third person in these frames.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thin white-cream tracer streaks from gun to target.
quickref.impact_end_result: Big cream-white starburst (core ~#FAF4DA) with long pale-peach rays (~#F4CF9E) swallowing the target. The magenta arcs seen around the gun are the Bearscream Sandwich buff, not the weapon.

quickref.look: Silver-white HASR retexture with a dark gunmetal ring loop.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Soft magenta muzzle glow (~#F43AD2); small magenta dots/bolts in flight (bolt reading inferred). 2026 Sci-Fi ASR also fires magenta orbs.
quickref.impact_end_result: Magenta-pink orb burst with white core (~#FE7CFC) on the struck bear (2016). Yellow stars and bars in Jan 2014. 'Button' function undocumented.

quickref.status: Original BBR v1.0 primary, 110,000 J. HUD 60/60 in Nov 2017 (matches wiki). A 2021 ring-rifle at x/50 has an uncertain identity.
quickref.look: Olive/salmon AK-style rifle with a large red-grey ring loop (HUD icon salmon with red ring).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Tiny white-yellow sparkle flecks at the muzzle (2017); no tracer seen.
quickref.impact_end_result: No attributable hit frame (2021 magenta flashes are confounded by a magenta-firing enemy).

quickref.status: Original BBR v1.0 primary, 60,000 J, level 10. HUD 80/80 in Jan 2014 (60 + Ammo +2).
quickref.look: Super-Soaker-style water gun with yellow tanks. The 'yellow droplets' in fjBn5OQZfyE are most likely its yellow tank parts.
quickref.impact_end_result: Unattributed red-orange spark bursts on a wall box in a Urine/Soaker clip; unknown.

quickref.status: Original BBR v1.0 secondary, 35,000 J. HUD 4 (2013 and Mar 2014), 3 (Apr 2014 overhaul). Reworked to rapid fire in 2021 (0/20 HUD; fan description).
quickref.look: Pink six-hex-tube muzzle ring, sage-green hex chamber, pink bulb rear, curled pink hose; unchanged in 2021.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Pellets never seen. 2021 version is rapid fire with a 20-round magazine.

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.2 (2012), 75,000 J, level 30. In-game model confirmed in the Jun 2013 v2.0 loadout.
quickref.look: Long, slightly curved silver katana with a wavy edge line, black guard, gold collar, dark hilt, held upright one-handed at about bear height.
quickref.impact_end_result: Not seen; use shared melee stars (inference).

soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: In BBG the Bearzooka is a coral hexagonal shoulder tube with glowing orange panels and grey hex collars. Its wide muzzle end has a pink hex cap around a dark bore, with a grey-and-coral checker band right behind the cap. It fires with a burst of round grey smoke puffs [Observed]. The 2026 trailer shows a grey hex rocket with glowing orange panels and a spiky orange flame tail [Observed; that it is the Bearzooka's is Inference]. The green hazard-striped tube is the BB Zombies design.
soul_corrections.evidence: 0ZbJ0-Za5Ws in-game render, crop /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/oliver-gaps/crops/bz_0ZbJ_muzzle.jpg; G1Z5XxhF6CU sd2 (Jun 2013 loadout); 0ZbJ0-Za5Ws maxres3 (grey puff launch); official trailer frames dl/oliver-gaps/tr_frames/r_017-r_019 (2.87-3.00 s); File:Bear.jpg (BBZ) per the verified dossier.

soul_corrections.correction: He holds the A Salt Rifle and shoulders the Bearzooka: a coral hexagonal tube with glowing orange panels, a pink hex muzzle cap with a dark bore and a grey-coral checker band just behind it.
soul_corrections.evidence: Same as above. The checker band sits at the muzzle end in the 2015 render (crops/bz_0ZbJ_muzzle.jpg).

[Fan-wiki]) and use the observed visuals: grey puff trail, hex rocket with spiky orange tail, soft yellow fireball. The beat stays a [BBG News invention].
